user_question: Can you provide a summary of the main purpose and content of this special event request form?
answer: This is a 1997 Special Event Request Form submitted by W.R. Knight from the St. Louis, MO division to San Zolot on July 11, 1997. The form requests promotional materials for two golf events: the Lorillard Metro Golf Outing (September 10, 1997, 140 attendees) and the Marcus Hellenic Spirit Charities Golf Classic (September 18, 1997, 350 attendees). The request includes 7 cases of cigarette samples (5 cases of Newport products and 2 cases of Kent products) and 400 water bottles with product code 99-980-2. The form includes shipping information and notes that confirmation was sent to SPZ on September 1, 1997.
